response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT sf.instownpct, tr.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  WHERE sf.instownpct IS NOT NULL
    AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM matched
), mix_averages AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
), above_average AS (
  SELECT m.instownpct, m.ordertypedist, o.avg_ownership
  FROM matched AS m
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE m.instownpct > o.avg_ownership
)
SELECT
  AVG(a.instownpct) AS average_ownership,
  AVG(a.instownpct / ma.avg_ownership) AS average_ratio_to_mix_average,
  AVG(a.instownpct - a.avg_ownership) AS average_excess_overall
FROM above_average AS a
JOIN mix_averages AS ma
  ON ma.ordertypedist = a.ordertypedist;

assumptions.assumption: The overall ownership average and each order type mix average use the matched rows with nonmissing institutional ownership and a nonmissing order type; the above-average cohort is selected against that same overall average. Each matched row contributes equally, without rounding intermediate values.
